meta.title: Parley — Record the meeting, then hand it to the AI you already use
meta.description: Parley is a free, open-source meeting recorder for Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android. The Mac captures both sides of a call and the phone records the room; the transcript arrives live and split by speaker, the debrief writes itself, and every recording is searchable. A built-in MCP server hands the whole library to Claude or whichever AI you use.
meta.ogTitle: Record the meeting. Then hand it to the AI you already use.
meta.ogDescription: A free, open-source meeting recorder: live transcript split by speaker, a debrief when it ends, search across everything — and an MCP server that hands it all to Claude or any AI you use. Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android.
meta.ogImageAlt: Parley: Record the meeting. Then hand it to the AI you already use. A live transcript with a blue waveform.
ld.features: Live transcript split by speaker, Both sides of a call on the Mac, In-person recording on the phone, Import existing recordings, A debrief shaped by the kind of meeting, Search across every recording, Automatic titles and filing, Built-in MCP server (54 tools), Your choice of transcription and model providers, Voice typing
hero.h1:
Record the meeting.
Then hand it to the AI you already use.
hero.sub: Live transcript while you talk — then ask your AI about it.
hero.fine: Free to use, or bring your own keys.
demo.alt: Illustration: a renewal meeting being transcribed live.
demo.line1: We're happy with the platform overall. The blocker is the seat count — we budgeted for forty and the quote came back at eighty.
demo.line2: Forty is the floor on the enterprise tier, so I can't go under it. What I can do is hold this year's price through the next renewal.
shot.liveAlt: Parley on the desktop during a meeting: the live transcript on the left, coaching notes in the middle, the to-do list on the right
meetings.h2: Put the phone on the table.
meetings.p: The transcript appears as people talk, speakers told apart.
meetings.altRecord: The iPhone recording screen: a transcript for Speaker A and Speaker B, the waveform and an 18:47 timer
meetings.altTranscript: A recorded meeting on iPhone: highlights, then the transcript split by speaker with timestamps
after.h2: The report is written before you leave the room.
after.p: Takeaways, commitments and next steps — every line plays back its moment.
after.alt: A Parley meeting report on the desktop: where it landed, commitments, what is still unknown and action items, each line with a timestamp
find.p: <kbd>⌘K</kbd> to any meeting — search down to a line said a year ago.
find.alt: ⌘K over the desktop library: typing “renew” lists the Renewals folder and the Northwind renewal meeting
ai.h2: Your AI can read every meeting.
ai.p: Connect Claude or any MCP client with one command.
ai.codeLabel: The command that adds Parley to Claude Code
ai.chatAlt: Illustration: asked “What did we promise Northwind?”, an AI searches Parley and answers, each point with a timestamp that plays back that moment.
ai.chatA: Hold this year's price through the next renewal0:27, and send the revised quote with the security questionnaire by Thursday1:32.
account.h2: Recorded on the phone, open on the computer.
account.p: Records offline and syncs when you're back online.
account.altDesktop: All recordings on the desktop, by date, with folders for Renewals, New business and Internal in the sidebar
account.altPhone: The iPhone library: meetings by date, with upload markers and folders
voice.h2: Say it, and it's already tidy text.
voice.p: Talk instead of type in any app — <kbd>⌥ Space</kbd> on a Mac.
voice.raw: so <s>um</s> before the Northwind meeting on Tuesday we need three things, first the quote, second the <s>uh</s> security questionnaire, and then <s>like</s> the onboarding timeline
voice.out:
Before Tuesday's Northwind meeting we need:
  1. The quote
  2. The security questionnaire
  3. The onboarding timeline
trust.h2: Your conversations go where you decide.
dl.windowsNote: On Windows, Parley records your microphone; if SmartScreen appears, choose More info → Run anyway.
